sources.entry: ccstatusline by sirmalloc - A highly customizable status line formatter for Claude Code CLI that displays model info, git branch, token usage, and other metrics in your terminal.

summary.one_liner: ccstatusline is an interactive, highly customizable status line formatter for the Claude Code CLI that shows model info, git state, token usage, usage limits, and other metrics in the terminal.
summary.what_it_does: It renders a configurable status line for Claude Code by reading the status JSON Claude Code provides and combining selected widgets into one or more lines. Widgets cover model, context length and percentage, token input/output and speed, session cost and duration, git branch, status, ahead/behind, worktree, origin/upstream owner and repo, and PR/CI status, plus Claude usage, reset timers, cache hit rate, extra usage, voice, vim mode, skills, and a custom command widget. An interactive React/Ink TUI, launched through npx or bunx, lets you add, remove, reorder and recolor widgets, pick Powerline or standard layouts, and set flex/right-alignment. Settings are saved to a JSON file and can be exported, validated and imported. The README also describes installing the command into Claude Code's settings.json, with optional pinned global installs, and a persistent git cache plus caching for expensive lookups.
use_cases: Show model, git branch and token usage in the Claude Code prompt bar
Track Claude Code context window and session cost while coding
Monitor Claude usage limits and reset times in the terminal
Build a Powerline-style status line for Claude Code
Display git status, PR and CI state next to the Claude session
Back up or share a status line configuration as JSON
how_to_run: Choose Pinned global install in the TUI to write "command": "ccstatusline" to Claude Code settings.json
Run ccstatusline --version to print the installed version
notable: Interactive TUI for configuring multiple status lines, with a live preview
Powerline mode with arrow separators, caps, themes, and auto-alignment
Usage widgets that read Claude usage data and reset timers, with optional proxy support
Persistent git command cache with TTL and HEAD/index mtime checks
Config export/import that previews changes before replacing or merging
caveats: Status line runs once per repaint; bunx with @latest adds noticeable startup delay, so a pinned global install is recommended for speed
Windows setup, fonts and troubleshooting are in a separate docs/WINDOWS.md file
Some widgets depend on newer Claude Code versions (for example, refresh interval needs Claude Code 2.1.97 or later; session cost needs 1.0.85 or later)
Localizations listed in the README are third-party forks that the project does not maintain or endorse
